original_benchmark.notes: JAXBench level1 at AI-Hypercomputer/accelerator-agents commit 7afeb78 (17 priority kernels + 33 KernelBench-L2 fused operators). Upstream ships the evaluation harness (python -m JAXBench evaluate) but no agent runner; the paper's methods (best-of-N, iterative refinement, Autocomp) are not released as runnable agents.

harbor_adapter.parity_costs: $120 (≈$40 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash API + ≈$80 GKE spot TPU v6e, ~116 chip-hours; both sides, incl. failed attempts)
harbor_adapter.notes: 11p_Megablox_GMM is excluded (its upstream baseline cannot be compiled). Parity uses the 15-task --split parity subset (1p 3p 4p 8p 12p 15p 16p 18k 22k 26k 30k 34k 38k 42k 46k), 3 runs per side, with mini-swe-agent added to a fork of the original benchmark (Scenario 2). Every task needs one TPU v6e chip (GKE environment).
